description: Mars has no GPS and no global magnetosphere—a dust storm blinds an astronaut in seconds. We are ARIADNA (Autonomous Reckoning & Inertial Astronaut Direction Network Architecture) strike team, focused on disciplinary hardware, biomedical, architecture, and building an EVA survival navigation system. We combine a custom RTOS wrist HUD running magnetometer-free 6-DoF inertial dead reckoning with Free-Space Optical (FSO) laser beacons that obliterate positional drift to 0.0m.
